claim: Every functional co-op MAP callback is accounted for across the shipped startup bytecode and the source scripts compiled when worldspawn loads a map; startup script.bin is not incorrectly treated as a complete co-op map program.

format_boundary.rule: Each co-op script.bin is the compiled program for its sibling *_main.script compilation unit and its includes, not necessarily for maps/vv/xbox_coop/<map>.script.
positive_examples: xc_admin_main.script includes script/map_admin.script and the corresponding callback is compiled.
xc_mcu_main.script includes script/map_mcu_1.script and both close_secdoor callback records resolve to compiled bytecode.
xc_mars_city2_1_main.script includes AI/player/coop scripts but not the sibling map script, so its three functional MAP callbacks are source-compiled at map load.

limits: Presence in startup bytecode proves only the six listed records; the other 54 rely on the independently audited shipped map-load source.
This boundary audit does not replace trigger-order, save/load or two-peer gameplay acceptance.
